title: PII discovery signal orchestration and role-aware trace replay
creator: Liam Chen
description: Problem: Our tracing and logs pipelines currently surface attribute-level PII in inconsistent ways across tenants, which complicates debugging and violates least-privilege access controls. We need a discovery + orchestration layer that: (1) emits deterministic PII discovery signals from ingestion, (2) tags and routes data to redaction/retention policies, and (3) enables role-aware, auditable just-in-time (JIT) reveal and replay for debugging without broadening persistent access. Scope: implement discovery hooks in the ingest proxy and trace collector, add a signal bus for governance decisions, extend RBAC checks for replay requests, and add initial dashboarding/alerts for policy violations. Out of scope for this ticket: full encryption-at-rest redesign and multi-region data residency routing (followups).
acceptance_criteria: PII discovery hooks emit structured signals for span attributes and logs (attribute key, matched pattern, confidence, salted-hash id)
Signal bus persists immutable audit events for every discovery and every JIT reveal action
Role-aware replay flow implemented: replay requests require scoped approval and generate time-limited access tokens; raw payloads are masked unless unmask permitted
Retention configuration can quarantine discovery-tagged data to short-ttl storage tiers via existing retention controller
At least one RBAC policy (support-engineer role) is documented and enforced end-to-end
End-to-end integration tests covering discovery->redaction->reveal and audit logs added to CI
tasks: Add lightweight PII detectors to ingest proxy (regex + trained classifier fallback)
Define discovery signal schema and produce to governance topic
Extend retention controller to subscribe to discovery topic and apply quarantine TTLs
Implement JIT reveal service with short-lived signed tokens and access logs
Add RBAC checks to replay API and surface approval modal in Console
Create dashboard for discovery events, quarantine actions, and reveal audits
Write integration tests and run perf benchmarks on ingest path impact

2025-01-24 Rhea Kapoor: Proposal to use deterministic salted hashing for pseudonyms to allow coarse joinability for debugging while avoiding raw values. Trade-off: joins across tenants must be prevented; decided to include tenant salt in hash.
2025-01-27 Priya Malhotra (Security): Raised concern about classifier false positives; recommended opt-in for high-sensitivity detectors and enforce audit trail for reveals.
2025-01-29 Engineering sync: Agreed to prefix discovery signals with confidence score and detector id. Low-confidence matches will be routed to a review queue rather than automatic quarantine.
2025-02-01 Rhea Kapoor: Spike completed on ingest latency; naive regex detectors add ~0.8ms P50. Plan to gate classifier invocations to <1% sample for now to limit cost.
2025-02-03 Liam Chen: PR for discovery signal schema opened; awaiting feedback from platform infra and security teams. Added integration test checklist.
decisions: Use deterministic salted-hash pseudonymization for attribute-level IDs to keep debugging linkability without revealing plaintext
Keep raw payloads out of the replay response by default; allow controlled unmasking via JIT reveal with approval
Gate heavy-weight ML detection to sampled traffic initially; rely on regex family for 95% of matches to minimize latency impact
Audit events for discovery and reveal must be immutable and retained for 90 days in the observable audit store (policy to be revisited)
Implementation will reuse existing retention controller and RBAC primitives where possible to reduce rollout risk
